newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: BIL sells FCL Energy stake - sources.
newsitem.headline: BIL sells FCL Energy stake - sources.

text.p: Brierley Investments Ltd has sold its four percent stake in Fletcher Energy Ltd, market sources said on Friday.
BIL, in line with its company policy, declined to confirm or deny it had sold the stake.
BIL bought the shares at an average price of around NZ$3.00 per share against the Thursday's closing price of $4.93.
BIL in June last year bought into FCL Energy shortly after Fletcher Challenge spun of three of its so-called "letter" stocks, against market sentiment.
Fletcher Energy had 351 million shares on issue before recent repurchases by the Fletcher employee trust.
The New Zealand Herald on Friday reported BIL's exit price was between 485 and 492 cents per share. It said BIL would book a net profit of $26 million on the deal.
There have been volumes of a few million FCL Energy shares traded on several days this week, including nearly 4.3 million on Thursday.
